New Viet Home - Long Biên 1 Ngo 109 Duong Nguyen Van Cu 1 Ngo 409 Nguyen Van Cu, Long Bien, Ha Noi, Hanoi, Vietnam Map Hanoi > Bed & Breakfasts > New Viet Home - Long Bien Hanoi View all photos New Viet Home - Long Bien Nestled in Long Bien, which is a developing residential area that draws visitors and their cameras to its namesake bridge, an elegant French-era steel structure spanning the Red River, New Viet Home - Long Bien Hanoi hotel is 2.8 km from such cultural places of interest as the famous Hoa Lo Prison. The bed & breakfast also includes parking. This comfortable hotel is located just a 5-minute walk from Chua Ai Mo and is 25 minutes' stroll from the Lake of the Restored Sword. The majestic church "Saint Joseph Cathedral" is just near the New Viet Home - Long Bien, while Doi dien chua Ai Mo bus stop is around 200 metres away. The property is also in proximity to Hoan Kiem Lake. Guests can find the Temple of Literature, which is 3.6 km away. New Viet Home - Long Bien hotel is 3.5 km from Ha Noi train station. There are private bathrooms with a bidet and a shower in the rooms.
